description: Vorbourg is the limestone spur above the Birs gorge east of Delémont, where a small pilgrimage chapel clings to the rock beneath a ruined medieval keep and the square Tour Sainte-Anne. The river runs far below between steep woods. This is not the baroque château already catalogued in the town. The Open-Meteo model is heavily clouded and mild, with no rain.
